name: QuantumCTek Co., Ltd.
summary: QuantumCTek Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of quantum communication, computing, and measurement products in China. The company offers quantum-secure communication network core equipment, including MAN and BN QKD, portable ground station for satellite QKD, channel and key network switching, and fixed network encryption application products; and quantum-secure application products, such as quantum security services mobile engine, quantumbuds, quantummail, quantum meeting, quantum identity security system, qukey, qtcard, quantum security intelligent office books, and quantum security HD walkie-talkie.
